description:
The JMAP Chat spec at ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/ has accumulated 16 commits on draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 since the workspace last synced with it. Most are softenings (MUST→SHOULD), impl-defined latitude grants, and clarifications. A handful are genuine new normative requirements.

Two surveys confirmed (2026-05-12):
- Chat crates are mostly already aligned (the big wire-format edits — capability cap-field drop, ReadDisposition, SpacePatchOp shape, extras policy — already landed)
- Three categories of remaining work exist, sized below

Scope confirmed with Mark (2026-05-12): "3 existing crates + CID" — defers federation/filenode-chat-companion/chat-calendars/chat-tasks to separate epics filed but not worked.

Trait shape decision (Mark, 2026-05-12): Add new policy hooks directly to ChatBackend with sensible defaults (matches the existing `limits()` precedent). Production backends override only what they need.

CID placement decision (Mark, 2026-05-12): Create a new jmap-cid-types crate (not folded into jmap-base-client). Future-proof for when CID grows beyond Blob/FileNode.

## Architecture posture (per workspace AGENTS.md)

The kit ships:
1. Correct wire format (struct fields, parse-time validation, round-trip)
2. Backend trait hooks where the spec calls for enforcement
3. Reference MemoryBackend stubs (intentionally demonstration-only)

The kit does NOT enforce policy. That's the consumer's job (kith, stoa, testjig, third-party). Slow-mode rate-trackers, blocked-contact lookups, scheduler-driven hard-delete on senderExpiresAt, etc. all plug in via the trait hooks.

## Layer breakdown

**Layer A — Wire-format & parse-time validation (5 beads)**
A.1 supportedBodyTypes field on ChatCapability (chat-client)
A.2 Reject SpaceRole.position == 0 as invalidArguments (chat-server)
A.3 Parse reaction patches in Message/set update (chat-server)
A.4 Space/query non-member preview field gating (chat-server)
A.5 Doc-comment confirmation on ChatContact.id URI-form latitude (chat-types)

**Layer B — Backend trait hooks (6 beads — 5 trait methods + 1 handler integration)**
B.1 ChatBackend::is_contact_blocked + Chat/typing handler integration
B.2 ChatBackend::may_set_custom_emoji + CustomEmoji/set handler integration
B.3 ChatBackend::slow_mode_check + Message/set handler integration
B.4 ChatBackend::retains_edit_history + Message/get/changes handler integration
B.5 ChatBackend::expire_message + Message/set readAt/burnOnRead handler integration
B.6 (rolled into each of B.1-B.5 above)

**Layer C — Already-filed (no new work; just unblock)**
C.1 De-label JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3 (Role+Member apply_space_patch) per JMAP-tqhv
C.2 Resolve JMAP-tqhv

**Layer D — CID (new crate)**
D.1 jmap-cid-types crate skeleton (Cargo.toml, lib.rs, AGENTS.md, README.md, PLAN.md)
D.2 sha256 typed field on Blob upload response surface (in jmap-base-client, re-exporting CID type)
D.3 supports_cid() advertisement on Session (jmap-base-client)
D.4 Workspace integration (root Cargo.toml, AGENTS.md crate map, dependency tree diagram)

**Layer E — Filed but NOT worked this pass (deferred companion specs)**
E.1 [epic] draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 → new jmap-chat-federation-{types,server,client}
E.2 [epic] draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 → new jmap-chat-filenode-{types,server,client}
E.3 [epic] draft-atwood-jmap-chat-calendars-00 → new jmap-chat-calendars-{types,server,client}
E.4 [epic] draft-atwood-jmap-chat-tasks-00 → new jmap-chat-tasks-{types,server,client}

## Acceptance

- All Layer A, B, D children closed
- Layer C unblocked (JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3 de-labelled, JMAP-tqhv closed)
- Layer E epics filed (open, no children, ready to be picked up in a later session)
- cargo test --workspace passes
- cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
- cargo fmt --all clean
- Crate citations updated to reference current draft commits where appropriate
